title: A simple high performance liquid chromatography method for determination of rebamipide in rat urine
author: Cooper, Harirforoosh
materials: Rebamipide stock solution was prepared by dissolving 10 mg rebamipide powder in 200 mL methanol for a final concentration of 50,000 ng/mL. Ofloxacin was used as an internal standard (IS). Ofloxacin stock solution was prepared by dissolving 100 μg ofloxacin powder in 200 mL acetonitrile. Standard solution was then vortex mixed until fully dissolved for a final concentration of 500 ng/mL.

steps.title: Dose rats and collect urine
steps.instruction: Administer rebamipide to male Sprague‑Dawley rats at 30 mg kg⁻¹ via gastric intubation twice daily for two days; on day 3 give a single morning dose and immediately place rats in metabolic cages to collect urine for a 12 h period.

steps.title: Prepare rebamipide stock solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 10 mg rebamipide powder in 200 mL methanol to obtain a stock concentration of 50 000 ng mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Prepare ofloxacin internal standard
steps.instruction: Dissolve 100 µg ofloxacin in 200 mL acetonitrile, vortex until fully dissolved to give an internal‑standard solution of 500 ng mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Extract rebamipide from urine
steps.instruction: Perform liquid‑liquid extraction of each urine sample as follows:

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL urine to a clean glass tube.
Spike with 100 µL ofloxacin internal‑standard solution.
Transfer the supernatant to a new clean glass tube.
Reconstitute the residue in 200 µL mobile phase.
Place the reconstituted solution in an HPLC injection vial.

steps.title: Set up HPLC conditions
steps.instruction: Configure the Shimadzu HPLC system with a C18 analytical column, set the flow rate to 0.5 mL min⁻¹, and use a fluorescence detector set to excitation 320 nm and emission 380 nm.

steps.title: Inject samples and acquire chromatograms
steps.instruction: Inject the reconstituted extracts (and calibration standards) onto the column, run the method, and record chromatograms; observe the internal‑standard peak at approximately 4.2 min and the rebamipide peak at approximately 9.1 min.

steps.title: Process data and calculate concentrations
steps.instruction: Using Shimadzu LC‑Solutions software, plot peak‑area ratios (rebamipide/IS) of the low‑ and high‑range calibration standards to generate linear calibration curves, calculate rebamipide concentrations in the urine samples from these curves, and note that the coefficient of variation is 18.9 %.

description: Rebamipide urine analysis was carried out using samples obtained from a previous study [5]. In the study, male Sprague-Dawley rats were dosed with rebamipide (30 mg/kg) twice daily for two days via gastric intubation. On day three, animals received one dose of rebamipide in the morning then were transferred to metabolic cages for a 12 h urine collection period. Analysis of rebamipide concentrations in the urine involved preparation of rebamipide stock solution, development of low and high linear standard calibration curves to compensate for altered rebamipide concentrations noted in urine samples, use of acetonitrile and hydrochloric acid for urinary rebamipide extraction, and HPLC analysis of rebamipide using a Shimadzu HPLC system. HPLC analysis was carried out using a C18 analytical column with a flow rate of 0.5 mL/min and a fluorescent detector set at an excitation wavelength of 320 nm with an emission wavelength of 380 nm.
